title: Cooperation as Routing: simulation, calibration and GitHub handoff analysis
description: Code and results for K. Hayashi, 'When Does Crediting Forwarders Help? An Agent-Based Model of Help Routing Calibrated to Handoffs in GitHub Issues'. Agent-based comparison of no credit, delivery credit and effective-forward credit on lattice, small-world and scale-free networks; calibration of engagement to @-mention handoffs in GitHub issues (GH Archive, March 2024); engagement sweep with branching ratio; sensitivity and scaling.
